svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 609 mm square blank; mark the three cut circles 280, 380 and 480 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the 480 mm circle for a 20 in box fan (the smaller lines suit 12 and 16 in fans)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Score and fold four 30 mm flaps down, as for the tray

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 110 x 16 mm hand hole in two opposite flaps

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stick the foam gasket as a 510 mm square round the opening, ends butted

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: flaps drop over the panel tops; the fan frame sits on the gasket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the fan's guard circle sits inside the cut circle all round
